newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - May 19.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - May 19.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Monday:
* Philippine shares are likely to slip further but will not fall as steeply as on Friday when the composite index crashed below its 2,600 support to a year-low of 2,576.13, traders said.

* Uncertainties on U.S. rates and the Manila Central Bank's raising of overnight borrowing rates by seven percentage points to 20 percent will further dampen interest in the equities market, said Mary Grace Balbuena, assistant vice president for sales at Sapphire Securities.
* The U.S. Federal Open Market Committee is set to meet on Tuesday to decide on interest rates.

* Anscor Hagedorn Securities Philippines Inc predicts more pain for the already black-and-blue market. "After staying afloat for two weeks, the market has proven that it continues to be at the mercy of factors it has no control over," the brokerage firm said in an advisory to clients.

Among the factors that will dictate the tempo of the local equities market this week are the movement of the foreign exchange market in the region, particularly the baht, and the result of the U.S. Fed meeting.
